paragraphs: Common words Indians mispronounce or misspell — separate, accommodation, recommend — with the right form and a memory trick.
A small word used wrong breaks trust. Here are 50 daily words with the correct form.
"Separate" has "a rat" in the middle. "Accommodation" = two cots in a room (cc, mm).
Learn 5 words a day. Write each 3 times. Say it aloud. The SpeakNow spelling drill tests you weekly.
Correct small words build a big reputation.
